title: New Year's Eve
about: A mess of New Yorkers chase love and second chances in the hours before the ball drops in Times Square.
cue: Serve the drinks as the ball drops at midnight.
faces: The ball has to drop at midnight and I've got a thousand things that can go wrong. Wish me luck.

avocados1 red onion1 bunch of corianderCut small rounds from the tortillas with a 6cm cutter and brush with oil.Bake at 200°C until crisp, then cool.Toss the peeled prawns with lime juice and chilli flakes.Mash the avocados with lime juice and salt.Thinly slice the red onion.Soak the onion in lime juice for 10 minutes.Top each crisp with avocado, a prawn, a few onion slivers and a coriander
